findings.text: The beyond-the-bound test fails at the base revision on AttributeError for EXEC_IDENTITY_FOREIGN_HOST_MAX_AGE_SECONDS rather than on a behaviour difference: the pre-change sweep already removed a foreign host's file whose pid is dead locally, so the assertion would have held at a4ca8b6c had the constant existed, and the landing fragment's claim that all three base failures name behaviour the base cannot have is not true of this one (it only guards the new code against keeping such a file forever).

An identity file that cannot be read falls through to local pid judgement: read_exec_identity returns None and the host reads as unknown, so a foreign host's file whose token cannot be read is removed inside the bound when its pid is absent here — the same removal this node exists to prevent — while _foreign_identity_is_kept deliberately keeps a file whose stat fails. Both unreadable cases should keep the file.
